---
# Preprint of the manuscript in journal mode (two columns). The text and metadata come from
# vmac_reversal_manuscript.qmd, so only the format is set here, at the end of this file
format: apaquarto-pdf
---

{{< include vmac_reversal_manuscript.qmd >}}

---
# Settings placed after the manuscript replace those of vmac_reversal_manuscript.qmd
journal: "Preprint"
volume: "This version has not been peer reviewed"
copyrightnotice: "2026 The Authors"
# Non-breaking spaces, so that no name is split across lines
authorsdisplay: "Francisco Garre-Frutos\\*, Pablo Martínez-López\\*, Adriana Ariza, Ricardo Rey-Sáez, David Luque, Miguel A. Vadillo, Felisa González"
# The header-includes of the manuscript lose their backslashes when included
header-includes: \raggedbottom
# With the CRediT statement, the author note is longer than a column and cannot be placed
suppress-credit-statement: true

format:
  apaquarto-pdf:
    documentmode: jou
    citeproc: false
    # latexmk loops with the column balancing of journal mode
    pdf-engine: xelatex
    keep-tex: true
    filters:
      - at: pre-ast
        path: scripts/preprint.lua
    include-in-header:
      text: |
        \usepackage{array}
        \usepackage{float}
        \usepackage{threeparttable}
        \newcolumntype{P}[1]{>{\raggedright\arraybackslash}p{#1}}
        % Spacing around figures, and better line breaks in narrow columns
        \makeatletter
        \setlength{\@fptop}{0pt}
        \setlength{\@fpsep}{12pt}
        \setlength{\@fpbot}{0pt plus 1fil}
        \setlength{\@dblfptop}{0pt}
        \setlength{\@dblfpsep}{12pt}
        \setlength{\@dblfpbot}{0pt plus 1fil}
        \makeatother
        \setlength{\textfloatsep}{12pt}
        \setlength{\intextsep}{12pt}
        % The author note is a float at the bottom of the first column, and it is longer than
        % the default 30% of the page, which sends it (and every figure after it) to the end
        \renewcommand{\bottomfraction}{0.9}
        \renewcommand{\topfraction}{0.9}
        \renewcommand{\dbltopfraction}{0.9}
        \renewcommand{\textfraction}{0.07}
        \renewcommand{\floatpagefraction}{0.8}
        \renewcommand{\dblfloatpagefraction}{0.8}
        \usepackage{microtype}
---
